view-01.png.evidence: Broad striped deck and long wake read beneath many overlapping pale planes; player remains obscured by wings and dots.

view-02.png.evidence: Raised bridge, visible dark hull side and larger plane establish more height; soft deck and water still limit material detail.

view-03.png.evidence: Produce, wood, stone and fabric are distinct under coherent cast shadows; thin paths remain legible in crowded market.

view-04.png.evidence: Numerous hard gray smoke clumps and orange pinpoints obscure the deck and aircraft; deep offset shadows imply altitude but add visual clutter.

view-05.png.evidence: Hangars show strong dark walls and light roofs, with a dirt service compound; coarse grass is busy and larger player overlaps similarly blue-gray roof.

view-06.png.evidence: Broad pale quiet deck separates well from teal water; raised bridge and wake help, while surfaces remain softly shaded.

view-07.png.evidence: Service compound, sheds, tracks and runway form clear geography; shaded trees ground the scene but material lighting remains modest.

view-08.png.evidence: Larger blue-edged player is visible above shoreline and buildings have dark side faces; coarse grass grain competes with fine tree detail.

view-09.png.evidence: Layered fog, trees, ruts and weathered shed make rich terrain; low-contrast gray tanks are difficult to isolate.

view-10.png.evidence: Broad striped deck has clear water contrast and long wake; bridge shadow adds depth with simple surface response.

view-11.png.evidence: Full-width deck is discernible in the aircraft swarm, but wings share its pale color and soft particles crowd player.

view-12.png.evidence: Sharp raised bridge and deep hull side provide height, with readable strips and long wake; deck itself remains uniformly lit.

view-13.png.evidence: Wet reflections, rain, smoke and tracer light are integrated; small dark infantry blend into debris.

view-14.png.evidence: Player edging and tree tones support hierarchy; partial compound adds purpose, while fields remain plain rectangles.

view-15.png.evidence: Edged player separates from mottled grass; tree variety and compound enrich coastline but scene remains soft.

view-16.png.evidence: Sharp full-width deck and wake clarify ship; pale aircraft lose contrast when crossing deck.

view-17.png.evidence: Larger planes and deep shadows provide height; smoke clumps and small flames obscure bridge and deck, with weak connection to a specific impact.

view-18.png.evidence: Larger outlined plane reads above coast and dark building sides establish height; blurry high-contrast grass adds noise without clear material form.

view-19.png.evidence: Raised hangars and dirt compound supply structure, but soft coarse grass and player/roof overlap reduce clarity.

view-20.png.evidence: Rooms have convincing wall depth, warm/cool light, wooden and tiled floors and detailed furniture.

view-21.png.evidence: Service structures and tracks make purposeful terrain; edged player is visible, but ground is broadly mottled and roofs simple.

view-22.png.evidence: Sharp raised bridge and aircraft shadows give height; gray clumpy smoke and orange flecks add action but interrupt deck readability.

view-23.png.evidence: Broad tan ship separates from water with a long wake; similarly pale aircraft overlap deck and remain hard to isolate.

view-24.png.evidence: Detailed machinery and atmospheric cliffs surround a layered luminous explosion; intensity obscures nearby units.

view-25.png.evidence: Sharper smoke clumps and flame fragments give much more activity, but dense gray clusters cover deck and merge with planes; shadows add yet more shapes.

visible_regressions: Views04/25: dense opaque-looking gray smoke clusters obscure planes and deck much more than soft dots in views11/01; readability drops to5.5.
Views17/22: isolated gray clumps and orange flecks interrupt structure without a clear impact focal point.
Views05/19: enlarged player overlaps a similarly colored hangar roof; greater object height does not guarantee player separation.
Views08/18: coarse grass grain adds visual noise relative to restrained mottling in views14/15.
top3_gaps: Reduce smoke density and opacity around the player and spread effects into recognizable stages rather than uniform clumps.
Use material-specific illumination and contact detail; louder ground texture does not substitute for surface depth.
Maintain a player cue that survives roof, deck, smoke and aircraft overlap.
_summary.blinding_limitations: All25PNGs individually inspected; no keys/source/outside files read. Recognizable unchanged controls keep exact prior vectors.
